Kidney Effect: Nephrolithiasis, crystalluria, dysuria, papillary necrosis, acute kidney injury, interstitial nephritis;Ritonavir may increase toxicity of indinavir
Kidney tubular damage: proximal tubular dysfunction, Fanconi syndrome, nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, acute tubular necrosis, acute kidney injury
Clinical Recommendations: Patients taking TDF should be monitored for signs of tubular dysfunction, including elevated serum creatinine, hypophosphatemia, low serum uric acid, acidosis, glycosuria, and proteinuria
